title: Plant
description: One plant as the Verdant mock API returns it (fictional demo data). The card binds a subset (see the spec's Data binding); care-task-row references plants by id. Derived fields are baked against the scenario's fixed fictional today (handoff/verdant/scenario.json's today).

health.description: long-run condition — distinct from status, which is care urgency

status.description: worst status among the plant's not-done care tasks, derived against the fictional today

x-derived.rule: the worst status among the care tasks whose plantId is this plant's id and whose done is false, ranked overdue, then due, then ok; ok when it has none.

photoUrl.description: site-relative image path; optional — never present in the demo data (no image assets in fixtures), so the card's monogram placeholder is the exercised path
